name: Roman
source:
Occupation: Owner of Ecto
Likes: Control, devotion, skin care
Dislikes: Disobedience, piercings, his family

Roman is the leader of the crime syndicate Ecto, the biggest threat to Strexa. Roman is egotistical and dominating and has little patience for failure. His ruthless tactics make him both highly successful and highly dangerous. He despises Dima and this obsession fuels his every move. The consequences are steep for anyone who questions those motives.
